descriptions.zh: 您在调用此接口查询A号码报备状态前，请先调用[CreatePhoneNoAReport](~~2880908~~)或[CreateFixedNoAReport](~~2881429~~)接口进行提交A号码手机号或固话个人实名信息。具体操作请参见[API提交A号码个人实名信息](~~2880077~~)。
descriptions.en: Before you invoke this API to query the reporting status of an A number, you must first submit the real-name information for the mobile or landline A number by calling the [CreatePhoneNoAReport](~~2880908~~) or [CreateFixedNoAReport](~~2881429~~) API. For detailed instructions, see [Submit real-name information for an A number via API](~~2880077~~).
